release_notes:
FocusShield v1.4.9 — Redesigned Restricted App Experience:
• Dynamic App Identity: Intercepted screen now fetches and displays the authentic target app icon (Instagram, YouTube, Snapchat, etc.) within a specular tactile frame.
• Cyber-Shield Intercept Badge: Pinned hardware lock emblem and live jewel LED status capsule (FOCUS DEFENSE ACTIVE / DAILY LIMIT ENFORCED).
• Hardware Bento Telemetry Panel: Inset debossed wells tracking your live Focus Credit balance and session unlock duration.
• 3-Way Tactical Action Hub: Instant session unlock with available credits via physical 3D gloss button, academic 2-minute quiz challenge (+20 Credits), and 1-tap parent Quick Pass.
• Interactive Quick Pass Modal: Clean preset reason chips (School Work, Urgent Chat, Family) and duration selector (15m, 30m, 45m).
• Redesigned Study Hours Gate: Cohesive tactile console showing exact schedule end time and direct Return to Focus action.
